title: Bringing CRM into the flow of work and agents into business process for sales and service teams
summary: The traditional boundaries of business applications are disappearing. For decades, people went to their customer relationship management (CRM) to find customer context, take action, and move work forward. AI is inverting that model. This shift creates two complementary opportunities: greater individual productivity and organization-wide process transformation.
